registration.statement: The least binary cover of generator-three successor volume fixes ceiling seven. Complete positive divisibility enumeration then leaves exactly prime sectors two, three, five and seven; each sector p has p charge labels, coupling (p-1)/p and exactly p-squared pair cells less the unique colourless return, hence mediator counts three, eight, twenty-four and forty-eight. The next prime eleven lies beyond the ceiling.
